question: Does an exact primary historical source support a film-base total-internal-reflection geometry that is materially distinct from an unconstrained Gaussian halo, before any modern-stock parameters or photograph rendering are introduced?

source.title: Sensitometry of Photographic Emulsions and a Survey of the Characteristics of Plates and Films of American Manufacture
source.rights_basis: United States federal government Bureau of Standards publication; retained as primary-source research evidence.

reviewed_observations.fact: The source distinguishes halation from emulsion irradiation and attributes the halo around a bright point on dark background to light reflected inside the glass or celluloid support.
Light reaching the rear support surface at or beyond the critical angle is returned toward the coated side; the source identifies that returned light as the halo cause.
Halo size depends on support thickness and critical angle, with the latter derived from refractive index.
An index-matched light-absorbing backing suppresses the reflected return.
The source states that the same mechanism occurs in film and that thinner film support produces less spreading than glass support.

allowed_after_pass: Freeze one generic analytical support-return kernel family whose inner support follows thickness and critical angle.
Use explicit uncalibrated thickness, refractive-index and attenuation hypotheses only in synthetic witnesses.
Compare topology against an equal-energy/equal-second-moment Gaussian control.
forbidden: Do not infer a modern stock's support thickness, refractive index, backing absorption or returned energy from this 1922 source.
Do not call any derived kernel VISION3, CineStill, calibrated halation or measured film response.
Do not fit kernel parameters to photographs or reopen frozen P3D-P3P experiments.
Do not promote from source or synthetic evidence.

branch_rule.pass: Open U6.P3Q1 analytical base-return geometry synthetic audit with separately frozen hypotheses and gates.
branch_rule.fail: Close the geometry route and continue another distinct physical mechanism.

claim_ceiling: Primary historical mechanism evidence for support-mediated total-internal-reflection halation; not modern-stock material data, a measured PSF, calibration or product authorization.
